_: Shared fixture set for the scanned-PDF threshold. server: the decision of PyMuPDF (scan.py) and of pdftotext (apps/api scan-rule.ts in the pdfbirlestirme monorepo), the 80% rule. browser: the pdf.js sample (packages/engine text-stats.ts): the browser samples as many evenly spaced pages as the server needs for a rejection (ceil(0.8 × N)) (sampleIndices(N, scanSampleSize(N, sampleMax)); at most sampleMax = 50, and if more are needed (N > 62) there is no pre-check), and rejects only if ALL sampled pages are low-text; the server then rejects too, even if every unsampled page has text. If browser is true, server must be true as well. mixed-25p: one of the text pages (2) falls into the browser's sample (sampleIndices(25, 20)); the browser lets it through, the server rejects it (Review Focus 1). counterexample-20p: every page of the old 12-page sample (sampleIndices(20, 12)) is scanned and 5 of the remaining 8 pages have text; the server accepts it (75%) and the browser does not reject it either (the spec §5.2 counterexample). Page kinds: T = long Turkish text, I = image only, N19/N20 = exactly 19/20 non-whitespace characters (with NBSP, thin space and narrow NBSP in between).
